title: Review of lab 1's autopoiesis/phase_trait (ID) on fresh seeds 5 and 6: planted phase-field bodies divide persistently (22 and 23 persistent splits, generation 3 on both, 0-1 merges) into a packed population of ~40 cells
summary: labkit re-runs of threads/autopoiesis/worlds/phase_trait/world.py on fresh seeds 5 and 6 with the pack's settings (frames 160, spf 300, t=48000, 128^2). Five planted bodies grow into crescents and rods that pinch into daughters. By t~15000 the domain holds a packed population of ~40 round cells that keep dividing, with dumbbells visible up to t=48000 (rerun/seed5/sheet.png). Seed 5: 42 splits, 22 persistent, max generation 3, 0 merges. Seed 6: 39 splits, 23 persistent, generation 3, 1 merge (original pack: 26/28/21, generation 4/3/4). Occupancy saturates at 0.40, so late divisions are replacement in a full domain.

observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png: ~40 discrete round cells persisting from t~15000 to 48000
observations.D: rerun/seed5 and seed6 FACTS: 22 and 23 persistent splits, max generation 3 from planted founders, merges 0 and 1

verdicts.limitation: Planted founders; generation 3 exactly meets the planted-founder bar. The domain fills (occupancy 0.40), so later reproduction is turnover in a packed population. The trait's selection (lab 1's L7, Weak) was not examined.
